# Your models and savings. One click away.

Your model, savings, and session activity, right beside your conversation. Edgee replaces its old statusline with an interactive sidebar. Click [+] at the bottom right of Claude Code to open it.

Try Claude Mod Read the docs

Bundled with Edgee · Claude Code 2.1.287+ · Edgee MCP enabled

Claude Code terminal with the conversation on the left and the Edgee Mod sidebar showing model selection, tokens, and estimated savings on the right.

## One click opens the full picture

Start with a compact bar above your prompt. Click [+]to open the sidebar and interact with your session. Click [−]to fold it away and keep coding.

Choose your model

### A model picker beside your conversation [...] ## Watch the sidebar in action

See how Edgee fits into your Claude Code workflow.

Watch on YouTube

## Launch Claude Code with the Mod included

No separate Mod installation. Start with the latest Edgee CLI and a supported Claude Code version.

1. 1

   ### Install or update Edgee

   Install the Edgee CLI, or run edgee update if you already have it. Use Claude Code 2.1.287 or newer.
2. 2

   ### Launch Claude Code

   Run edgee launch claude. The Mod loads automatically with Edgee MCP enabled, starting with a compact bar above your prompt.
3. 3

   ### Click [+] to explore

   Click [+] at the bottom right of Claude Code to open the sidebar. Pick a model, explore your savings, and follow your session. Click [−] to collapse it.
